'''Gendoraan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Dal Rogos]] claimed to be a [[Language/Legends|languages]] [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]] from Gendoraan as part of his cover identity.<ref name="GA">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref>
